title: Atomic multi-target damage-skill resolution with per-target facts
objective: Generalize the already-verified negative absolute HP damage-skill mechanic to enemy-all/row/column target sets while spending MP once and preserving target identity in resolved facts.
claim_boundary: No original PAL3 damage formula is claimed. This experiment reuses the existing deterministic absolute-HP effect only; healing, statuses, ally damage, ElementPosition geometry, Unity presentation/runtime and VFX remain outside scope.
design_constraints: Keep CombatEvent and SkillCastResolution ABI unchanged.
Use additive MultiTargetSkillCastResolution<TKey> and TargetSkillResolution<TKey> types.
Spend MP once per cast, never once per target.
Reject invalid semantics, empty target sets, insufficient MP and damage overflow before any target mutation.
Reject aliased combatant-state instances before mutation, including caster-as-enemy-target aliasing.
Delegate target discovery/order to verified CombatTargetResolver<TKey>.
Preserve one overall SkillCast fact and target-associated Damage/TargetDefeated facts.

attempts.description: Initial code-bearing branch with resolver, 16 tests, and pre-CI state-alias hardening.
attempts.failure: Source Audit run 32354067564 stopped before C# tests because 0018-multi-target-state-alias-guard.patch was corrupt at line 29. 0016 and 0017 applied successfully; this was a unified-diff hunk-count error, not a code-semantic result.
attempts.fix: Correct 0018 hunk header from +164,23 to +164,24. No resolver semantics changed.

attempts.description: Rerun the exact same resolver/test semantics after correcting only the 0018 unified-diff hunk count.

verified_invariants: Enemy-all/row/column target selection is delegated to the verified target resolver.
Defeated targets are omitted before mutation.
MP is spent exactly once per cast, not per target.
Each selected target receives independent clamped damage and defeat state.
One overall SkillCast fact is emitted, with target-associated Damage and optional TargetDefeated facts.
Empty target sets, insufficient MP, invalid skill semantics and int.MinValue damage overflow reject before MP/HP mutation.
Distinct target keys cannot alias the same CombatantState, and caster state cannot appear as a selected enemy target.
Result/event collections are read-only wrappers rather than raw arrays.
Existing single-target resolver and Projectile presentation ABI remain unchanged.
transaction_review: After all preconditions and target-state alias checks pass, the resolver spends MP once and enters a mutation-only section whose normal domain operations are positive ApplyDamage calls followed by result/event construction from already-valid skill IDs and positive applied damage. No expected business-rule exception remains after the first mutation, preventing normal partial-cast failure states.
reusable_lessons: Patch-format failure must be classified separately from C# compile/test failure.
Unique keys are insufficient for mutation safety when multiple keys can alias one mutable state instance.
For multi-target actions, validate every semantic/resource/identity precondition before the first state mutation.
Preserve target identity outside the generic CombatEvent ABI instead of breaking an already-verified single-target presentation contract.
next_recommended_experiment: Step 5C should add a pure multi-target presentation planner that consumes MultiTargetSkillCastResolution target facts without owning target selection or damage truth; after that, Step 6 can introduce healing/support semantics.
